title: Juicy Crispy Japanese Mushroom Gyoza
description: A solo dinner Japanese dish featuring mushroom and crispy gyoza, with a low sodium content and fatty flavor, achieved through salt baking.

ingredients.name: Mushroom
ingredients.notes: Shiitake or cremini mushrooms, finely chopped

instructions: In a large mixing bowl, combine the chopped mushroom, sesame oil, soy sauce, salt, and black pepper, and mix well.
Lay a gyoza wrapper on a flat surface and place a small spoonful of the mushroom mixture in the center of the wrapper.
Dip your finger in a small amount of water and run it along the edges of the wrapper.
Fold the wrapper into a triangle by bringing the two opposite corners together to form a point, and press the edges together to seal the gyoza.
Repeat the process with the remaining wrappers and mushroom mixture.
Heat about 1-2 inches of sesame oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat until it reaches 350 degrees Fahrenheit.
When the oil is hot, add a few of the gyoza to the skillet, being careful not to overcrowd it, and fry until the bottom is golden brown.
Use a spatula to carefully flip the gyoza over and fry the other side until it is also golden brown.
Remove the gyoza from the oil with a slotted spoon and place them on a paper towel-lined plate to drain excess oil.
Serve the gyoza hot, garnished with chopped green onion and a sprinkle of salt, if desired.
